app.title: Minerva Story: guided multiplexed tissue image viewer
app.summary: A reader opens a published exhibit: a gigapixel tissue image tiled at many resolutions, with a narrated story laid over it. They step forward and back through the story's waypoints. Each waypoint moves the view to a set position and zoom, switches on a chosen group of colored marker channels, and shows a passage of text, which can also be played as audio. A lens can show a second channel group, such as the H&E stain, inside a circle over the fluorescent markers. At any point the reader can leave the story to pan, zoom and switch channel groups freely, then return to the next waypoint.

task.text: Present a very large multichannel tissue image as a guided, narrated tour that readers can also explore freely.

data.text: One very large multichannel microscopy image, stored as tiled image pyramids. Its channels are arranged in named, colored groups. A story of waypoints adds text descriptions and saved views.
data.item: a waypoint: a saved position, zoom level and channel group on the tissue image, with a text description

stage.text: sharing and explaining multiplexed tissue images after imaging and analysis, alongside a publication

mechanism.text: A deep-zoom image viewer fills the screen, driven by a story file. Each waypoint sets the pan, the zoom, the active channel group and the narrative text. A channel-group switcher and an optional lens recolor what the viewer shows, so the guided path and free exploration share the same view.

field.text: multiplexed tissue imaging (CyCIF and H&E) in cancer pathology

workflow.name: follow a narrated guided tour through a large image, then explore it freely

steps.here: build_page loads exhibit.json, which lists the image pyramid, its channels, the channel groups and the story waypoints, and draws the image full-screen

steps.step: step through items one at a time
steps.here: Forward and back controls move through the story's waypoints. Each one sets the pan, the zoom and the active channel group, and shows its markdown description.

steps.step: switch which layer of the data is shown
steps.here: Switch between named channel groups (Overview, Immune 1–3, Autofluorescence, H&E). Each group is a fixed set of markers with set pseudocolors and legend descriptions. A settings icon colorizes or hides individual channels.

steps.step: compare two layers in the same place
steps.here: A circular lens of set radius shows the H&E brightfield group inside it, over the fluorescent marker group shown outside it
Leave the story to pan and zoom freely across the tiled pyramid, down to single-cell resolution, then return to a waypoint
Waypoint descriptions are turned into MP3s offline by a text-to-speech script and stored under a speech bucket. The viewer plays them as an audio guide.

distinctive: the image is gigapixel and multichannel, so it is served as tiled JPEG pyramids at several resolution levels rather than loaded whole
the channels are curated into named groups of 4–8 markers, each marker with a pseudocolor and a description
a lens shows a different staining modality (H&E) in a circle over the fluorescent channels at the same location
the waypoint text can be played aloud from MP3s made ahead of time, like a museum audio guide
the whole story is a static JSON file, so the exhibit can be hosted on any static web server

parts.title: Deep-zoom tissue viewer
parts.summary: Fills the page with the multi-resolution tissue image, which the reader can pan and zoom, and builds the story interface from the exhibit file.

parts.title: Exhibit definition
parts.summary: A JSON story file that declares the image pyramid and its size, the layout, the header text and the channel list the viewer is built from.

parts.title: Story waypoints
parts.summary: An ordered list of narrated stops the reader moves through, each setting the zoom, the pan, the channel group and the text.

parts.title: Channel groups
parts.summary: Named sets of marker channels with pseudocolors and descriptions that the reader switches between to change what the image shows.

parts.title: Multimodal lens
parts.summary: A circle of set radius that shows another channel group, such as H&E brightfield, over the fluorescent group shown around it.

parts.title: Waypoint narration generator
parts.summary: An offline script that turns each waypoint's description into an MP3, keyed by a hash of the text, so the viewer can play the story aloud.
